# Insights screen catalog

See [`../../../docs/spec-agent-input-guide.md`](../../../docs/spec-agent-input-guide.md) before requesting a new or changed screen.

Canonical Insights screen packages use `<MeaningfulPascalCaseName>_<StableID>` under this directory. The prior `screens/P4` and `screens/P2-P3` roots are retired. `S-P23-01` is an embedded reusable panel and lives under `domains/insights/common/frontend`, not this screen registry.
